releaseNotes:
• Serialized Headless Web Bridge & Isolation: Unique request ID tracking on WebKit bridge prevents cross-delivery of media across concurrent resolutions.
• Non-Blocking Fast Embed Race: First-completed valid media detection cancels competing network probes in sub-300ms, eliminating head-of-line stalls and false-winner empty pages.
• Scoped Storage Deletion Synchronization: Extended SelfDeleteGuard across the entire batch transaction to eliminate race conditions with MediaStore ContentObserver, plus conditional URI matching.
• Clipboard Privacy Protection: Redacted arbitrary clipboard text dumps from telemetry, keeping your clipboard private.
• Foreground Service Stability (Android 14-16): Added immediate clean exit on startForeground failures to prevent RemoteServiceException ANR crashes, and guarded background start restrictions.
• Fragment Lifecycle & ActivityResult Hardening: Scoped deletion consent handling safely to Fragment lifecycle with state survival across process recreation.
